meta.method: Assign each cause/effect node to the bechina-based package whose essential nature it shares. Polarity inherited from the receiving package.

assignments.reason: The Torah explicitly states 'עִקָּר הַדָּבָר שֶׁבּוֹ תָּלוּי בְּחִינוֹת מָשִׁיחַ הוּא שְׁמִירָה מִנִּאוּף' — guarding from sexual immorality is the primary thing upon which the Mashiach-dimension depends. Its essential nature is the protective guarding of the Mashiach-chotem (nose) domain. Niuf is already in Package 1 as the evil side; shmirah mi-niuf is the good-side guarding of the same nose/Mashiach domain.

This node is a direct verbal variant of the dominant node of Package 1: 'each person has a bechina of Mashiach according to his holiness and purity.' Its essential nature is identical to משיח and רוחו של משיח — the Mashiach-dimension that resides on the holy books.

The Torah states 'כָל אֶחָד כְּפִי קְדֻשָּׁתוֹ וְטָהֳרָתוֹ, כֵּן יֵשׁ לוֹ בְּחִינַת מָשִׁיחַ' — holiness and purity are the prerequisite dimension that determines one's Mashiach-level. The ruach kina'ah is described as arising 'לגדל קדשתו וטהרתו' — its essential nature is the purity/holiness quality that is the foundation of the Mashiach-spirit. This belongs in Package 1 as the qualifying condition of the Mashiach domain.
This is another verbal variant of the Mashiach-bechina — 'each person has a bechina of Mashiach.' Its essential nature is identical to the dominant node משיח in Package 1.

The Torah states 'כָּל רְחִימוּתָא דְּלָא קְשִׁיר עִמָּהּ קִנְאָה, לַאו רְחִימוּתָא רְחִימָא' — love that does not bind zealousy to itself is not true love. Great love is the positive interior of the ruach kina'ah. The Torah identifies love as inseparable from zealousy — it is the inner motivating force of the Mashiach-spirit's zealous guarding. Its essential nature is the ahavah-dimension of the ruach kina'ah, belonging in Package 1.

This node describes the act of zealous guarding (mekanei bah). Its essential nature is the active expression of ruach kina'ah — the dominant force of Package 1. The Torah treats zealousy as the operational mode of the Mashiach-spirit. This is the functional face of רוח קנאה.

This node describes the departure of the ruach kina'ah — 'the spirit of jealousy is removed.' Its essential nature is the ruach kina'ah itself (Package 1's core node), here in its withdrawn state. Whether present or departed, its identity remains that of the Mashiach-spirit domain.

assignments.partner_node: הצדיקים הגדולים להעלים תורתם, לשרפן ולהאבידן
assignments.reason: Verbal variant of the preceding node — 'so that the spirit of zealousy would be removed.' Same essential nature: the ruach kina'ah in its departed state. Belongs in Package 1.

This node describes the loss of the holy books. Its essential nature is the ספרים הקדושים — the holy books that are a bechina of שם ה (Package 2). The Torah states 'עַל יְדֵי אֲבֵדַת הַסְּפָרִים הַקְּדוֹשִׁים בָּא טוֹבָה' — the loss of the holy books brings good. The subject is the ספר domain.

This node describes the burning and loss of holy books — a verbal variant of אבדת הספרים הקדושים. Its essential nature is the ספר (Package 2). The books are 'שמי שנכתב בקדשה' — the same sacred-text identity as Package 2.

assignments.node_id: הצדיקים הגדולים להעלים תורתם, לשרפן ולהאבידן
assignments.node_text: הַצַּדִּיקִים הַגְּדוֹלִים לְהַעֲלִים תּוֹרָתָם, לְשָׂרְפָן וּלְהַאֲבִידָן
assignments.reason: This node describes the great tzaddikim concealing their Torah, burning and destroying it. The essential nature is the Torah/sefer that is being concealed — 'תורתם' and 'לשרפן ולהאבידן' refer to the hidden Torah-texts. Though the agent is the tzaddik, the object and defining substance is the Torah itself, placing this in the domain of Package 2 (Torah and the Holy Book).

assignments.node_id: שבשביל השלום שביניהן נמחין ונאבדין הספרים
assignments.node_text: שֶׁבִּשְׁבִיל הַשָּׁלוֹם שֶׁבֵּינֵיהֶן נִמְחִין וְנֶאֱבָדִין הַסְּפָרִים
assignments.partner_node: נושאין קל וחמר למעלה (כמו שאמרו רבותינו, זכרונם לברכה, (שבת קטז): ומה שמי שנכתב בקדשה, שהוא הספרים הקדושים הנ"ל, אמרה תורה – ימחה – בשביל להטיל שלום וכו, ספרי המינין שהם מטילין שנאה ותחרות בין ישראל וכו, על אחת כמה וכמה שימחו ויאבדו ויעקרו מן העולם,
assignments.reason: This node states that for the sake of peace between the holy couple, the books are erased and lost. Its essential nature is the sefarim — 'נמחין ונאבדין הספרים' — the holy books (שמי שנכתב בקדשה) being effaced. The books are the subject of the verb and the defining substance of this node, squarely within Package 2.

assignments.node_id: נושאין קל וחמר למעלה (כמו שאמרו רבותינו, זכרונם לברכה, (שבת קטז): ומה שמי שנכתב בקדשה, שהוא הספרים הקדושים הנ"ל, אמרה תורה – ימחה – בשביל להטיל שלום וכו, ספרי המינין שהם מטילין שנאה ותחרות בין ישראל וכו, על אחת כמה וכמה שימחו ויאבדו ויעקרו מן העולם,
assignments.partner_node: שבשביל השלום שביניהן נמחין ונאבדין הספרים
assignments.reason: This verbose node is the kal va-chomer argument: if the holy Name written in holiness (= the holy books) may be erased for peace, then the heretical books that sow hatred must certainly be destroyed. The entire argument revolves around the ספר/שם ה identity — 'שמי שנכתב בקדשה, שהוא הספרים הקדושים'. Its essential nature is the Torah-juridical reasoning about the sefer domain, belonging in Package 2.

This node describes the destruction of heretical books. Its essential nature is ספרי המינין — the evil mirror of the holy books in Package 2. The additions file already assigns ספרי מינין to Package 2 with evil polarity. This node is a verbose formulation of the same concept: the heretical books being uprooted from the world.

This node is the ultimate positive outcome of the entire teaching: being able to draw close to God. Its essential nature is closeness to Hashem — the state that becomes possible when the Mashiach-spirit's zealousy is properly managed. The Torah frames this as the final telos of the Mashiach mechanism: the ruach kina'ah guards the holy couple's union, and through the books' sacrifice the heretical books are destroyed, enabling closeness to God. This drawing-close is the fulfilled purpose of the Mashiach-domain (Package 1), not of the book-domain which is merely the instrument.
